site.name: Berlin Cinephile Club
site.description: A film club for movie lovers in Berlin. We pick a film by member vote every two weeks, watch it together at an arthouse cinema, and stay afterwards to talk about what we just saw. From classics to current festival hits.

json.title: How it works
json.content: Every two weeks we pick a film together through an open poll. We meet at an arthouse cinema in Berlin, watch the film in its original language, and stay afterwards for drinks and a moderated discussion. Newcomers are very welcome.

json.title: So funktioniert es
json.content: Alle zwei Wochen wählen wir gemeinsam per Abstimmung einen Film. Wir treffen uns in einem Berliner Programmkino, schauen den Film in Originalfassung und bleiben anschließend zusammen für Getränke und eine moderierte Diskussion. Neue Gesichter herzlich willkommen.

json.title: Suggest a film
json.content: Members can suggest films at any time. Once a suggestion is approved by an organizer it joins the next biweekly poll. The winning film becomes our next screening - simple as that.

json.title: Einen Film vorschlagen
json.content: Mitglieder können jederzeit Filme vorschlagen. Nach Freigabe durch einen Organisator landet der Vorschlag in der nächsten Abstimmung. Der Gewinner wird beim nächsten Filmabend gezeigt - so einfach ist das.

rows.title: Parasite
rows.description: A poor family schemes to become employed by a wealthy household and infiltrate their lives one by one.

rows.title: In the Mood for Love
rows.description: Two neighbours form a bond after both suspect their spouses of infidelity, in 1960s Hong Kong.

rows.title: Drive My Car
rows.original_title: ドライブ・マイ・カー
rows.description: A grieving stage director forms a quiet bond with the young woman assigned to be his driver.

rows.title: The Zone of Interest
rows.description: The commandant of Auschwitz and his wife build a dream life in a house next to the camp wall.

rows.title: Perfect Days
rows.description: A Tokyo toilet cleaner finds contentment in routine, music, books, and the small beauty of everyday life.

rows.title: Aftersun
rows.description: A woman recalls a holiday with her young father twenty years earlier, piecing together who he was.

rows.title: Past Lives
rows.description: Two childhood friends separated by emigration meet again in New York twenty-four years later.

rows.title: Anatomy of a Fall
rows.description: A writer stands trial for her husband's death, with their half-blind son as the only witness.

rows.title: Burning
rows.description: A young writer suspects the wealthy stranger who befriended him of something he cannot prove.

rows.title: Shoplifters
rows.description: A makeshift Tokyo family living off petty theft takes in a neglected girl, and their secrets unravel.

rows.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
rows.original_title: Portrait de la jeune fille en feu
rows.description: A painter sent to a Breton island must paint a reluctant bride without her ever sitting for it.

rows.title: The Handmaiden
rows.description: A pickpocket is planted as maid to a Japanese heiress in a con that keeps changing hands.

rows.title: Roma
rows.description: A year in the life of a live-in housekeeper for a middle-class family in 1970s Mexico City.

rows.title: Cold War
rows.description: Two musicians love each other badly across two decades and both sides of the Iron Curtain.

rows.title: First Cow
rows.description: Two drifters in 1820s Oregon build a small fortune on milk quietly taken from the territory's only cow.

rows.title: Petite Maman
rows.description: Clearing out her grandmother's house, an eight-year-old meets a girl her own age in the woods.
